notes: Base catalogue: en-gb locale (same base as prior Home-Decor pass, see notes/150.md). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Main nav has a top-level 'NEW' section; sitemap.xml lists exactly two URLs under /en-gb/new/: /en-gb/new/all/items and /en-gb/new/all/available-soon. Tried guessing New-Home-decor / New-Tableware sub-split URLs analogous to the Sale section's structure (new/all/home-decor, new/all/tableware, new/new/home-decor, new/new/tableware) - all 404, confirming New has no genuine sub-categories, unlike Sale. Rendered both real candidates with Playwright (tier 2; raw SSR HTML carries no count text, same Coveo-grid situation as Bestsellers/Sale): (1) /en-gb/new/all/items - breadcrumb Home > NEW > All new, H1 'NEW', real product grid with Filter/Sorting, filter-bar summary '77 results' (also parsed as '77 products' in surrounding copy, consistent) - INCLUDED as the New Arrivals PLP. (2) /en-gb/new/all/available-soon - breadcrumb Home > NEW > All new > Coming soon, H1 'COMING SOON', copy 'Stay tuned for the launch of selected new arrivals for 2026. Enter your email address and you will be notified when your product is available', CTA is 'Get notified' (not 'Add to cart'), filter-bar summary '22 results' - EXCLUDED, not flagged ambiguous: this is a pre-launch/not-yet-released teaser listing, the direct opposite of 'recently added to the catalogue' (products are explicitly not yet available/purchasable), so it fails the brief's New Arrivals test even though it is a real, countable product grid. Recorded here for transparency, not emitted as a row.
